userFeedback: Close side-angle review exposed flat stone-separation strips floating beyond the curved lower and upper rim silhouettes; corrected in v5.

reviews.notes: The slimmer lower rim, broader pool, flatter tower cap, smaller upper bowl, and shorter finial match the supplied tier hierarchy more closely than v3.

All four spouts now use compact downward-aimed heads with tapered necks, circular mouths, subtle side-set eyes, gill plates, fins, and crests; the treatment remains deliberately procedural and mobile-readable.
Four pale streams leave the adjusted mouth positions, curve inward, and terminate in two concentric ripples plus a small splash stem.
Radial top joints and vertical riser joints remain continuous and flush across the plinth, lower basin wall, lower rim, and upper bowl, now using a warmer less distracting shadow tone.
The upper bowl is shallower, both copper collars are restrained, and the finial is compact with visible vertical grooves.
LOD0/1/2 remain strictly decreasing and under budget with five materials, eight LOD0 draw calls, three collider proxies, and no degenerate faces, loose vertices, missing scripts, or broken sockets.
